in_hebrew.name: Huntley
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Huntley הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘hunta’ (hunter) and ‘leah’ (clearing). The name Huntley may have originally referred to a place where hunters gathered. It is now a popular name for boys in the English-speaking world.

in_greek.name: Huntley
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Hunter's clearing
in_greek.long_meaning: Huntley είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English ‘hunta’ (hunter) and ‘leah’ (clearing). The name Huntley may have originally referred to a place where hunters gathered. It is now a popular name for boys in the English-speaking world.

in_latin.name: Huntley
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Hunter's clearing
in_latin.long_meaning: Huntley est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English ‘hunta’ (hunter) and ‘leah’ (clearing). The name Huntley may have originally referred to a place where hunters gathered. It is now a popular name for boys in the English-speaking world.
